title: Canadian Pilaf Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful Canadian pilaf dish with vibrant vegetables and crunchy seeds.
instructions: Cook the Canadian pilaf according to package instructions.
Heat the light olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the vibrant bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the poppy seeds and cook for an additional minute.
Combine the cooked pilaf and pepper mixture in a bowl.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with additional poppy seeds if desired.
